title: Construct the complete selected P104 Boolean scalar layer
body:
The complete selected PR6030 scalar layer now has literal Boolean circuits and a full gate/scratch bill. Existing PR3080 ADD circuits are reused unchanged. New in-place SCALE circuits use rotations, sign fill and a constant-specialized increment; COPY uses CNOTs. INIT and CLEAR are explicit charged reset requests, not an omitted implementation cost.

At 64 bits per real component, the complete word uses 4,701,068 Toffolis, 4,783,210 CNOTs, 38,610 NOTs and 3,968 bit-reset requests. One shared 63-bit clean carry bank suffices; no constant register or temporary arithmetic guard bits are needed. Multiply scalar gate/reset counts by 2D for complex dimension D. Physical carry-bank backing and routing remain open. The signed-power policy saves 672 Toffolis and 674 CNOTs against the explicitly constructed binary-power control; this small control comparison is separate from the implementation contribution.

Every one of the 19,288 scalar events passes a complete symbolic alignment proof for arbitrary coarse-grid native returns. Two full 22,803-event Boolean executions match rational traces and return every carry bit clean. Templates and bills at seven widths, 715 independent bit-list SCALE cases, full serialized width-64 circuits and three semantic controls pass. The source and numerical range interface is PR6499; its native/error/reset premises are not silently discharged.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal/optimized checks, committed bytes/modes, official export and read-only Git-free/empty-PATH normal/optimized replay pass at `1298247d11b979f1006fcb03d5ee2b3b468b26d0`. Hosted CI is pending. The optional full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout; both live source files come from the immediate main parent and are included in the export.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-boolean-scalar-layer`.

The compiler supports 26<=W<=256. Native children, actual resets, field/tape access, conversion, clean backing and all-size/outer admission remain open. Whole-word fixtures use native-grid stubs; they do not run the physical native maps. No full supplier, runtime saving, new kappa or selected-frontier change.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19363837). Canonical main, revision 8 and live claims were refreshed before submission. Credit Nick Petalas/PR3080, PR6499, DreamingOfClouds/PR6030, David Arias, Cinna Davis, Gareth Davidson, Ali Romman and the retained scalar/native/compiler authors. Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
